reasoning_content: My awk didn't work. Let me use a different approach to map ports to service names.

action.command:
cd /workspace
for port in 18005 18007 18008 18014; do
  name=$(grep -B45 "\-\-port $port " process-compose.yaml | grep -E '^\s+name: ' | tail -1)
  echo "port $port -> $(echo $name | tr -d ' ')"
done
